trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If only I have more time!
trap.right: If only I had more time!
trap.why: If only reforça wish. No presente: if only + passado; no passado: if only + had + particípio. O brasileiro usa o presente.

fix.right: If only we had left earlier!
If only he would stop talking!

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I wish I had more time.” (If only…)
rewrite.answer: If only I had more time!

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “I wish we had left earlier.” (If only…)
rewrite.answer: If only we had left earlier!

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I wish it would stop.” (If only…)
